content: Wal oni YAWEI det trubala God na hendulum det main blanga det king jis laik im hendulum det woda langa riba en meigim im randan langa raitwan pleis.
Pipul bilib dei oldei dumbat ola raitwan ting, bat YAWEI im sabi wanim olabat jinggabat.
YAWEI im oldei brabli gudbinji wen wi gibitbat feyago langa pipul en dumbat raitwan ting, dumaji tharran im mobeda langa detlot enimul sekrifais.
Wikitwan pipul larram det praudbalawei en det wei weya dei laigim miselp jidan bos oba olabat, en tharran im brabli nogudbala ting.
Detlot pipul hu meigim plen en dumbat adwek abum detmatj enijing, bat detlot hu dum detlot wek eniwei jidan powan.
Pipul hu tjidimbat enibodi blanga jidan ritjwan, jidan jis laik siliwan drim weya kaman en go kwikbala, en tharran na garra trepam olabat en meigim olabat dai.
Detlot wikitwan pipul garra binijimap miselp garram olabat ron krulbalawei, dumaji olabat nomo wandim dumbat ola raitwan ting.
Ola giltiwan pipul oldei jidanbat nogudbalawei, bat ola gudwan pipul oldei dumbat wanim im rait.
Im mobeda yu jidan ontop langa det ruf den yu jidan insaid langa det haus garram yu waif hu oldei agamin langa yu.
Detlot wikitwan pipul oldei laigim dumbat nogudbala ting langa pipul, nomeda if dei fren blanga olabat.
Wen sili pipul luk sambodi gedimbat panishmen dei len, bat sabibala pipul len wen sambodi titjimbat olabat.
God im oldei gibit feyago langa ebribodi. Im sabi wanim detlot wikitwan pipul oldei dumbat en im garra binijimap olabat.
If yu nomo album ola po pipul wen dei jingat langa yu blanga album olabat, wal wen yu wandim sambodi blanga album yu nobodi garra irrimbat yu.
If sambodi brabli wail langa yu, wal if yu gibit im presen sigridwei, wal tharran na garra meigim im jidan kwaitbala.
Wen nogudbala pipul abum panishmen, gudbala pipul jidan brabli hepiwan, bat nogudbala pipul bradin brabliwei.
If yu stap jinggabat raitwei yu garra faindim miselp langa greibyad.
Enibodi hu laigim jidanbat drangginbala en abumbat gudtaim garram olkain ting garra lujim ebrijing. Dei garra jidan powan.
Detlot wikitwan pipul dei oldei trai meigimbat trabul blanga ola gudbala pipul, bat det trabul im garra gobek langa olabat selp.
Im mobeda yu jidan langa deset kantri den blanga jidan insaid langa yu haus garram yu waif hu oldei agamin langa yu blanga olkain ting.
Ola sabibala pipul oldei jinggabat blanga pudumwei en seibum sambala mani en abum gudbala ting, bat ola silibala pipul oldei binijimap ebrijing dei abum streidawei.
If yu jidan kainbala en trubala, najalot pipul garra rispek langa yu, en yu garra jidan laibala longtaim.
Wanbala sabibala men gin bidim det taun weya garram detmatj solja, en im gin bitsimap det strongbala wol weya olabat oldei trastimbat blanga kipum miselp seif.
If yu oldei wotjim wanim yu tok, wal yu garra kipawei brom loda trabul.
If yu oldei reken miselp brabliwei en jidan brabli praudbala, wal pipul garra tok, “Yu laigimbat miselp!”
If yu wandimbat olkain ting en yu jidan leisiwan en nomo wek, wal maitbi tharran garra binijimap yu.
Bat detlot pipul hu oldei duwit langa God garra jidan brabli kainbala.
YAWEI nomo laigim detlot sekrifais weya detlot brabli nogudbala pipul oldei meigim garram olabat brabli nogudwan filing.
If yu dalim laiya langa kothaus wal yu garra binij. Oni detlot pipul hu tok trubala wed gin tok deya.
Detlot wikitwan pipul oldei tok laiyawei. Dei reken dei oldei sabi blanga dum enijing, bat najing. Bat detlot pipul blanga God oldei jinggabat gudwei bifo dei dum enijing.
Nomeda haumatj yu sabi en nomeda wanim plen yu meigim, yu kaan win if YAWEI nomo album yu.
Nomeda yu abum ola hosis redibala blanga wo, bat oni YAWEI na garra meigim yu win.
